profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Product-System Architecture | Observability & AI-Ready Systems
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer specializing in product-system architecture with 8+ years of experience building scalable, data-informed systems in regulated healthcare environments.

At Walmart, I’ve led architectural design across high-volume pharmacy initiatives, translating complex product requirements and persistent customer pain points into structured domain models, clear client/server state boundaries, and production observability systems. My work spans refill workflow redesign (Simplify Rx), legacy platform migration (Rx History), and front-end monitoring frameworks used by on-call teams to maintain API reliability and system health at scale.

I’m particularly interested in the intersection of product, platform, and data — where engineering decisions shape workflow clarity, reliability, and long-term system evolution. Increasingly focused on AI-enabled product systems, I’m exploring intelligent workflows, monitoring patterns, and feedback loops that support AI-ready architectures.

Core strengths:
• Product-system architecture
• Domain modeling & state boundary design
• Observability & analytics instrumentation
• Performance optimization & reliability engineering
• React, TypeScript, GraphQL
• Python & SQL

Fluent in English and Mandarin.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and lead product-system architecture for large-scale pharmacy platforms operating under HIPAA constraints, supporting high-volume and reliability-critical workflows.
🔹 Simplify Rx List — Refill Workflow Redesign
* Led structural redesign addressing a long-standing top VOC complaint around prescription clutter.
* Introduced hierarchical grouping (Store → Patient → Fills) with deterministic sorting logic.
* Improved refill clarity and reduced confusion-related escalations.
🔹 Rx History Migration — Architecture & State Boundary
* Defined separation between client state (Context) and server state (React Query) during legacy migration.
* Implemented scalable filtering and caching patterns, improving perceived load time and reducing redundant API calls.
🔹 Pharmacy Observability & Alerting
* Built dashboards monitoring API failure rates and workflow health.
* Defined event schema and alert thresholds used by on-call teams.
* Reduced issue diagnosis time (~30–40% MTTR) and supported ~99.99% availability.
🔹 Broader Platform Contributions
* Defined modular UI architecture across Rx Delivery and Import Rx initiatives.
* Reduced onboarding time from ~2 weeks to ~2–3 days through standardized patterns and documentation.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Built and deployed full-stack web and mobile applications from concept through production in a fast-growing startup environment.
🔹 People Help People Sales Management Platform
* Designed and developed web and mobile applications supporting commission reporting and messaging (5,000+ Android downloads, 4.8/5 rating).
* Developed RESTful APIs (Node.js) and asynchronous backend services.
* Improved backend response time by 23% and reduced frontend load time from 2s to 0.5s.
* Designed Cassandra schemas and deployed to AWS EC2 (150 QPS under load).
🔹 Tools Tracker — Real-Time Location Platform
* Contributed to real-time tracking system for technicians and assets.
* Implemented GeoHash-based algorithm improving tracking accuracy from ~3 miles to <1 mile.
* Built RESTful APIs and NoSQL schemas optimized for high-frequency updates.
This role provided hands-on experience in distributed systems, real-time data processing, and full lifecycle product delivery early in my career.

projects.title: Smart School Finder — Data-Driven Recommendation System
projects.description:
Designed and built an end-to-end data pipeline integrating multiple public and private K-12 school datasets into a canonical master model. Implemented data harmonization, entity resolution, deterministic ID mapping, and scoring logic to generate ranked school recommendations.

Developed structured feature matrices, preference segmentation layers, and exportable ranking artifacts for potential product deployment. Focused on system integrity, explainability, and AI-ready workflow foundations.

projects.title: Front-End Observability & Alerting Framework for High-Volume Healthcare Workflows
projects.description:
Designed and implemented a reusable front-end observability framework for pharmacy platforms, providing real-time visibility into API reliability, user workflow health, and error patterns across high-volume systems.

Defined event schema, logging standards, and alert thresholds (e.g., API failure rate %, unknown error spikes) used by on-call teams and engineering leadership to proactively detect and resolve system degradation.

Reduced production issue diagnosis time by ~30–40% (MTTR improvement) and supported ~99.99% availability during peak traffic periods.

Focus: Reliability engineering, monitoring loops, event instrumentation, and data-informed system integrity — foundational patterns for scalable, AI-ready product systems.
